title: Computer-use architecture and provenance freeze
objective: Freeze the post-v0.2 governed computer-use architecture and donor provenance before any new browser, capture, desktop-input, model-adapter, or remote-computer authority is implemented. Pin bytedance/UI-TARS-desktop@2ff41a9e515828c5bd5b276e493d73aa0bdf4a3a and any additional authorized donor revisions and source paths; classify every reused subsystem; define the canonical ComputerAction proposal vocabulary, browser/page/document/node/window/element/capture/input/remote-lease identities, process boundaries, protocol envelopes, failure invalidation rules, and license/dependency obligations; and prove that no donor runtime or authority is reachable yet.

include: pinned donor source ledger with exact repository revisions and source paths
per-subsystem REUSE_VERBATIM, ADAPT, PORT, REFERENCE_ONLY, or REJECT classification with destination and authority delta
license, NOTICE, attribution, modified-file, dependency, SBOM, and provenance obligations for each selected donor component

canonical typed identity vocabulary for browser profiles, engines, pages, page/document generations, browser nodes, process instances, windows/window generations, UIA elements, capture generations, approvals, input leases, capture leases, remote computer-use leases, policy revisions, and workspace trust revisions
canonical provider-neutral ComputerActionProposal schema carrying untrusted proposal data only
process-boundary design for a low-authority browser host and native desktop providers behind quntald

explicit denial list for arbitrary JavaScript/CDP, unrestricted shell/script execution, personal browser profiles, raw model-to-input execution, remote approval, model self-approval, silent coordinate fallback, and protected-surface automation
deterministic protocol-versioning, bounds, cancellation, crash/restart invalidation, and audit/event contracts
tests proving no P18 donor package, host process, browser launch/attachment, capture path, input path, new MCP tool, new profile, or remote mapping is reachable in this grain
exclude: launching or attaching to a browser

authority_delta.filesystem: None beyond governance/provenance records in the repository.

invariants: Quntal remains the sole authority for policy, trust, approvals, typed target identity, leases, destination policy, audit, revocation, and tool exposure
model/provider adapters remain untrusted syntax normalizers and cannot mint or widen authority
all authority-adding computer-use implementation remains blocked until a successor grain explicitly authorizes the exact delta
donor provenance and license obligations are recorded before code reuse

acceptance.claim: A pinned donor/provenance matrix records exact source revisions, paths, reuse classification, Quntal destination, license/dependency obligations, and authority delta for every selected UI-TARS subsystem.

The canonical computer-use action and target identity contracts, process boundaries, protocol envelopes, bounds, cancellation semantics, crash/restart invalidation, and denial list are deterministic and test-pinned.

Regression tests prove that no new browser, capture, desktop-input, model-adapter execution, remote-computer, MCP tool/profile, process, network, or privileged authority is reachable before successor authorization.
Exact-head CI, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, security review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved blocking threads all pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000074: Live isolated browser-host foundation may activate only after this architecture/provenance freeze closes canonically.

done_when: The governed computer-use architecture and donor provenance are frozen canonically with zero runtime authority delta and SG-000074 has an exact implementation contract to build against.
